test_cases.title: Enter results card on Home opens the Current Distributions page
acs: DERIVED: The Enter results card on /Home.aspx opens /DistributionsCurrent.aspx with h1 Current Distributions - route /Home.aspx to /DistributionsCurrent.aspx (also served at /ResultsEntry.aspx)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
The card opens the page by postback.
The page also responds at /ResultsEntry.aspx; the address path after the click is not asserted beyond the two known routes.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Look for the Enter results card under the Results section.
steps.expected: The Enter results card is visible.

steps.action: Click the Enter results card.
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the address path /DistributionsCurrent.aspx or /ResultsEntry.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Current Distributions.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: Current Distributions shows the empty-state message and no search form
acs: DERIVED: With no current distributions, /DistributionsCurrent.aspx shows the message There are no current distributions to display and has no search form - route /DistributionsCurrent.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
Local data has no current distributions. If the data set differs, this case does not apply.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionsCurrent.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Current Distributions and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the message in the main content area.
steps.expected: The message reads There are no current distributions to display.

steps.action: Look for the labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Code and Scheme Name.
steps.expected: None of these search labels are shown.

steps.action: Look for the SEARCH and SHOW ALL buttons.
steps.expected: Neither button is shown.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.expected: The h1 is still Current Distributions and the message is still shown.

test_cases.title: Previous Distributions shows the search form and the empty-state message
acs: DERIVED: /DistributionsPrevious.aspx shows the search labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Code and Scheme Name, the buttons SEARCH and SHOW ALL, and with no data the message There are no distributions to display - route /DistributionsPrevious.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
Local data has no previous distributions. If the data set differs, the message step does not apply.
Search is read-only. Nothing is entered into the search boxes in this case.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionsPrevious.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Previous Distributions and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the labels of the search form.
steps.expected: The labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Code and Scheme Name are shown.

steps.action: Look for the search buttons.
steps.expected: The SEARCH button and the SHOW ALL button are visible.

steps.action: Read the message below the search form.
steps.expected: The message reads There are no distributions to display.

steps.action: Reload the page.
steps.expected: The h1 is still Previous Distributions and the search form is still shown.

test_cases.title: Searching Previous Distributions with an unknown reference keeps the empty result
acs: DERIVED: A search on /DistributionsPrevious.aspx with a reference that does not exist keeps the message There are no distributions to display, and SHOW ALL restores the list - route /DistributionsPrevious.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active.
Local data has no previous distributions, so SHOW ALL returns the same empty message.
Search is read-only. No business data is created, saved or submitted.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionsPrevious.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The page loads with the h1 Previous Distributions.

steps.action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF in the Distribution Reference box.
steps.expected: The box shows ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF.

steps.action: Click the SEARCH button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Previous Distributions and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the message below the search form.
steps.expected: The message reads There are no distributions to display.

steps.action: Click the SHOW ALL button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Previous Distributions and the search form is still shown.

steps.action: Read the Distribution Reference box and the message.
steps.expected: The Distribution Reference box is cleared or empty and the message reads There are no distributions to display.
